Most animations are two segments "tall," but some are more.  

TALL vs TALLER MODE:  You will normally use the Tall setting.  However, if you know you are sending an animation to someone with an iPhone X or iPhone "Plus" you can choose to use the Taller setting, which will look better on these larger-display devices.
